panels.title: HTTP Sessions
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: this panel inventories servlet HTTP sessions via Spring Session's enumerable registry, but Quarkus is reactive/stateless by default and exposes no equivalent active-session registry to list (servlet sessions added via quarkus-undertow are not tracked), so it is not used here.

panels.title: Startup Timeline
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: startup steps are eliminated by build-time augmentation, so there is no runtime per-step buffer (Spring's BufferingApplicationStartup) to record a timeline; only coarse boot totals exist, so this fine-grained step timeline is not used here.

panels.title: GraalVM
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: Quarkus builds native images and generates its own reachability metadata at build time, so this Spring-oriented native-image readiness advisor is not used here.

panels.readOnlyReason: Runtime config overrides are not available on Quarkus (they target the Spring bootstrap property sources); properties remain fully visible.
panels.title: Configuration
Conditions
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: Spring Conditions reports @ConditionalOn… auto-configuration match outcomes, but Quarkus performs build-time augmentation and exposes extensions/capabilities and profiles instead — there is no runtime positive/negative condition-match graph to display.

panels.title: Spring Security
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: this panel reads Spring Security's filter chain and user store, which Quarkus does not run. Quarkus security (Elytron/OIDC, RBAC, TLS, CORS) is covered by the Quarkus-native Security advisor.

panels.title: Security Logs
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: Quarkus security events are disabled. Set quarkus.security.events.enabled=true (with a security extension) to capture authentication/authorization events.

panels.title: Scheduled Tasks
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application has no scheduler. Add the quarkus-scheduler extension and annotate a method with @Scheduled to enable the Scheduled Tasks panel.

panels.title: MySQL
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: no supported MySQL JDBC datasource is declared. Add quarkus-jdbc-mysql and configure an active JDBC datasource with db-kind=mysql or a recognized MySQL JDBC URL. Unknown declarations are not verified; MariaDB Connector/J (db-kind=mariadb) and reactive-only clients are not supported.

panels.title: Transactions
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: transaction boundary capture relies on Spring Framework's TransactionExecutionListener hook, registered against ConfigurableTransactionManager beans. Quarkus's transaction management goes through Narayana's JTA TransactionManager/Synchronization or the CDI @Transactional interceptor, neither of which exposes a comparable per-boundary listener without far more invasive instrumentation, so this panel is not used here.

panels.title: Spring Data
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: this panel enumerates Spring Data repository beans, which Quarkus does not run; Quarkus models persistence with Panache/Hibernate ORM instead — see the Hibernate advisor for mapping insight.

panels.title: Cache
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use Quarkus Cache. Add the quarkus-cache extension to enable the cache panel.

panels.title: Spring DevTools
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: Spring Boot DevTools restart/LiveReload has no runtime analogue. Quarkus dev mode owns live reload through build-time augmentation, with no stable runtime API to read or trigger it, so this panel is not used here.

panels.title: Flyway
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use Flyway. Add the quarkus-flyway extension to enable the Flyway migrations panel.

panels.title: Liquibase
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use Liquibase. Add the quarkus-liquibase extension and a change log to enable the Liquibase panel.

panels.title: CRaC
panels.unavailableReason: Not applicable on Quarkus: this CRaC checkpoint/restore advisor targets the Spring Boot startup model, and Quarkus's fast startup comes from build-time augmentation and native images instead, so it is not used here.

panels.title: REST Client
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use Quarkus REST Client Reactive. Add the quarkus-rest-client extension (with at least one REST Client interface) to enable the REST Client panel.

panels.title: Code Inventory
panels.unavailableReason: Requires the BootUI agent's inventory sensor: This JVM runs without the BootUI agent. BootUI works without it; attach it with one of the setup snippets to add agent-based evidence. Start the application with -javaagent:bootui-agent.jar (see the Java Agent panel).

panels.title: Code Paths
panels.unavailableReason: Requires the BootUI agent's code-paths sensor: This JVM runs without the BootUI agent. BootUI works without it; attach it with one of the setup snippets to add agent-based evidence. Start the application with -javaagent:bootui-agent.jar (see the Java Agent panel).

panels.title: Side Effects
panels.unavailableReason: Requires the BootUI agent: This JVM runs without the BootUI agent. BootUI works without it; attach it with one of the setup snippets to add agent-based evidence. Start the application with -javaagent:bootui-agent.jar (see the Java Agent panel).

panels.title: Email
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use the Quarkus Mailer. Add the quarkus-mailer extension to enable the Email Viewer panel.

panels.title: Kafka
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use Kafka messaging. Add the quarkus-messaging-kafka extension (with an @Incoming/@Outgoing channel) to enable the Kafka panel.

panels.title: RabbitMQ
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application does not use RabbitMQ messaging. Add the quarkus-messaging-rabbitmq extension (with an @Incoming/@Outgoing channel) to enable the RabbitMQ panel.

panels.title: JMS
panels.unavailableReason: Not yet available on Quarkus: BootUI's current JMS capture targets Spring JMS (JmsTemplate and @JmsListener). Use the Kafka or RabbitMQ panels for Quarkus Reactive Messaging.

panels.title: Fault Tolerance
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application has no fault-tolerance library. Add the quarkus-smallrye-fault-tolerance extension and annotate a method with @CircuitBreaker, @Retry, @Timeout, @Bulkhead or @RateLimit to enable the Fault Tolerance panel.

panels.title: WebSockets
panels.unavailableReason: Not available: this application declares no WebSocket endpoint. Add the quarkus-websockets-next extension and a @WebSocket endpoint to enable the WebSockets panel.
